primary_journey.title: Renter books a car and the owner approves it, consistently across both dashboards
steps: As Renter (Alex Rivera), open the marketplace and filter by Tesla
Open Tesla Model Y and pick start 2026-12-01 and end 2026-12-04
Review the price breakdown and submit the booking request
Open My Bookings and see the booking as Pending
Switch to the Owner account (Sarah Jenkins) and open Booking Requests
Switch back to Renter and open My Bookings
expected: Booking panel shows 3 days x $85.00 = $255.00 subtotal, $25.00 cleaning fee, $280.00 total
Request is accepted with a success message
The pending request appears with renter details
Status becomes Confirmed in the owner view
Renter sees the same booking as Confirmed
Booking and status persist after refresh
